notifications.body: Your removal of failure/digest/timer fate is right. Please check default nudge-on-checkpoint: root rejected unconditional runtime continuation because it loops forever. With claimOnce removed, what explicit assignment-done or orchestrator-stop path terminates generic pausable wave members? Keep caller-selected orchestration policy functional, but default every-checkpoint nudging must not accidentally become an infinite loop. Generic root report producer is committed 3a7e3af4, transport extension requested from wake-lead6. Please explain proposed default and explicit done path before final commit.

I will implement the remaining generic root_turn_reported transport amendment now in wake-delivery.mjs plus focused test, using existing attachment/receipt identity. Please tell me promptly if you already have code underway to avoid collision. Main now contains your production wiring and abb2d0de; generic emitter is 3a7e3af4. This closes plain pausable Runs and gives wave observers a root report without an automatic continuation loop.

Proposed #572 default/explicit-done contract: add an onCheckpoint callback to createWaveDriver. It receives {role,runId,requestId,claim/summary/digest} and must return continue|done|stop. continue calls nudge_turn; done calls claim_turn (the orchestrator explicitly declares assignment complete); stop records orchestrator stop and closes. Keep steering:nudge-on-checkpoint as an explicit caller-selected always-continue policy, terminating only on member terminal status or AbortSignal. It may run indefinitely by design, but must not be the implicit default. A driver created without an explicit steering choice or onCheckpoint should refuse before waves.start with wave_driver_turn_policy_required; this avoids starting work that either loops or parks without a consumer. checkpoint.claim alone remains evidence passed to callback, never a done signal. Generic application runs outside waves still need 3a7e3af4 plus wake-lead6 transport so a parent can issue the corresponding nudge/claim/stop. This requires small recipes callback/schema migration if you approve. Alternative is immediate claim of every checkpoint, but that treats turn completion as assignment completion and contradicts the observed projection semantics, so I do not recommend it. Please confirm the callback/refusal direction before I implement it.

Proceed with onCheckpoint continue|done|stop and explicit policy validation before waves.start. This is an orchestrator decision callback and claim_turn is valid only for explicit done. Preserve explicitly selected always-continue steering and caller AbortSignal, but remove implicit always-continue defaults from recipes too; a default injected by recipes is still runtime policy. Keep scope tight, migrate directly contradicted focused fixtures, and explain callback error/retry behavior without adding failure-count termination. Generic root transport now passes 7/7 on my union, including non-swarm run and null-run workers.
